newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Hebron talks resume in Jerusalem after bomb scare.
newsitem.headline: Hebron talks resume in Jerusalem after bomb scare.

text.p: Israeli and Palestinian negotiators resumed talks on a Hebron accord after a bomb scare disrupted their meeting at a Jerusalem hotel on Monday, a PLO official said.

The official said the talks resumed at the West Jerusalem home of U.S. Consul-General Edward Abington, about 300 metres (yards) from the Laromme hotel from which negotiators were evacuated earlier. The teams were expected to return to the hotel shortly to continue the talks.
